language.name: c
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y gcc make cmake gdb

language.name: cpp
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y g++ make cmake gdb

language.name: asm
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y nasm yasm gdb

language.name: python
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip

language.name: rust
language.install: su devuser -c 'curl --proto '='https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y'

language.name: js
language.install: apt-get update && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs

language.name: csharp
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y wget apt-transport-https && wget https://packages.microsoft.com/config/debian/12/packages-microsoft-prod.deb -O /tmp/packages-microsoft-prod.deb && dpkg -i /tmp/packages-microsoft-prod.deb && rm /tmp/packages-microsoft-prod.deb && apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0 aspnetcore-runtime-8.0

language.name: ruby
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y ruby-full

language.name: go
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y golang-go

language.name: java
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y default-jdk maven gradle

language.name: kotlin
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y kotlin && curl -s "https://get.sdkman.io" | bash && su - devuser -c "source ~/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && sdk install kotlin"

language.name: swift
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y binutils git libc6-dev curl

language.name: php
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y php php-cli php-xml php-mbstring php-curl composer

language.name: scala
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y scala-defaults sbt

language.name: r
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y r-base r-cran-littler

language.name: lua
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y lua5.4 luarocks

language.name: flutter
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y curl git unzip xz-utils zip libglu1-mesa && su devuser -c 'git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git /home/devuser/flutter && export PATH="$PATH:/home/devuser/flutter/bin" && flutter precache'

language.name: elixir
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y elixir erlang

language.name: haskell
language.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y ghc cabal-install

language.name: zig
language.install: apt-get install -y zig

service.name: rabbitmq
service.install: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y erlang-nox && apt-get install -y rabbitmq-server
